subject.title: [Control UI] 部分模块中文翻译缺失

question: Should this issue remain the broad Control UI zh-CN tab-interior tracker while maintainers sequence the focused localization PRs, or should it be narrowed in favor of a different localization epic?
rationale: Current main still has source-proven English tab copy, but multiple overlapping PRs and adjacent docs/runtime localization reports make the remaining scope a sequencing and product-boundary decision rather than safe autonomous implementation.

options.title: Keep Broad UI Tracker
options.body: Use this issue to coordinate tab-by-tab Control UI zh-CN fixes while requiring each PR to follow the generated i18n pipeline and avoid unrelated docs/runtime scope.

options.title: Narrow To Original Tabs
options.body: Limit this issue to Agents, Skills, Channels, Sessions, Nodes, and Debug, then route Settings, chat metadata, skill metadata, docs, and CLI localization to linked issues.

options.title: Supersede Into Epic
options.body: Move the remaining work to a broader localization epic only after selecting a canonical tracker and preserving this issue's concrete tab evidence there.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad UI Tracker
recommendation.body: Use this issue to coordinate tab-by-tab Control UI zh-CN fixes while requiring each PR to follow the generated i18n pipeline and avoid unrelated docs/runtime scope.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest current maintainer-routing signal from adjacent Control UI/i18n history and the issue discussions that ask for review attention.
